title: Laplacian acting on a function
statement: For every function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ and every point $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, the Laplacian of $f$ at $x$ is the sum, over all coordinates $i$, of the coordinate Laplacian of $f$ at $x$.
